questions.question_english: 20. Arrange the following ancient Sanskrit literary texts in chronological order of their composition (from earliest to latest):
questions.explanation_english: The chronological order of ancient Sanskrit literature begins with the Rigveda Samhita, composed during the Vedic period (circa 1500–1000 BCE). Panini’s Ashtadhyayi established formal Sanskrit grammar around the fifth to fourth centuries BCE. Bhasa composed classic Sanskrit dramas like Svapanavasavadattam around the third to second centuries BCE. Kalidasa flourished later during the Gupta period (fourth to fifth centuries CE), composing epic poems such as Raghuvamsha.

questions.explanation_english: The historical establishment of Sufi orders (silsilas) in India followed a sequential timeline. The Qadiriyya order expanded into South Asia during the fifteenth century. The Naqshbandi order gained significant influence later during the late sixteenth and seventeenth centuries under Khwaja Baqi Billah.

questions.question_english: 36. According to the classical Indian classification of musical instruments, which of the following is categorized as an ‘Avanaddha Vadya’ (percussion/membrane instrument)?
questions.explanation_english: Under the classical instrument taxonomy of Natya Shastra, Avanaddha Vadya comprises membranophones or percussion instruments that produce sound through a stretched membrane. Tabla, consisting of a pair of hand drums with tuned leather heads, is a premier Avanaddha Vadya in Hindustani music. questions.question_english: 60. Arrange the following historical art and sculptural schools of ancient and medieval India in order of their emergence (from earliest to latest):
questions.explanation_english: The chronological evolution of Indian art begins with the Indus Valley Civilization (circa 2500 BCE), famous for terracotta figurines and bronze sculptures like the Dancing Girl. Imperial Mauryan polished stone pillars developed in the third century BCE. Gandhara and Mathura sculpture schools flourished during the Kushan era (first to third centuries CE). Later, during the Chola dynasty (tenth to twelfth centuries CE), magnificent lost-wax bronze sculptures reached artistic perfection.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। भारतीय कला का कालक्रमिक विकास सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता (लगभग 2500 ईसा पूर्व) से शुरू होता है, जो मिट्टी के खिलौनों और कांस्य की मूर्तियों जैसे नृत्य करती लड़की के लिए प्रसिद्ध है। सम्राट मौर्य के चमकदार पत्थर के स्तंभ तीसरी शताब्दी ईसा पूर्व में विकसित हुए। गांधार और मथुरा की मूर्तिकला स्कूलों ने कुशान युग (पहली से तीसरी शताब्दी ईस्वी) के दौरान फल-फूल किया। बाद में, चोल वंश (दसवीं से बारहवीं शताब्दी ईस्वी) के दौरान, अद्भुत खोई हुई मोम की कांस्य मूर्तियों ने कलात्मक परिपूर्णता प्राप्त की।

65. Below are two statements, one labeled as
Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): The Golconda style of Deccani
miniature painting is renowned for its lavish
use of gold color and rich decorative drapery.
Reason (R): Golconda was a significant global
trading center for diamonds and textiles, which
brought immense wealth and international artistic
patronage to the kingdom.
options_english:
Both A and R are true and R is the correct
explanation of A.

Both A and R are true but R is not the
correct explanation of A.
A is true but R is false.
A is false but R is true.
questions.explanation_english: The correct option is (a). The Golconda style of Deccani miniature painting, which flourished during the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries under the Qutb Shahi dynasty, is celebrated for its opulent aesthetic, vibrant color palettes, and extensive use of gold leaf. Golconda's status as a major diamond trading center and textile hub contributed to its wealth, allowing royal patrons to support lavish court art that combined Persian elegance with local Deccan traditions.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। गोलकोंडा शैली की डेक्कानी सूक्ष्म चित्रकला, जो सोलहवीं और सत्रहवीं शताब्दी के दौरान कुतुब शाही राजवंश के अधीन विकसित हुई, अपने भव्य सौंदर्य, जीवंत रंगों की पैलेट और सोने की पत्तियों के व्यापक उपयोग के लिए प्रसिद्ध है। गोलकोंडा का एक प्रमुख हीरा व्यापार केंद्र और वस्त्रों का हब होने के नाते इसकी समृद्धि में योगदान दिया, जिससे शाही संरक्षक भव्य दरबारी कला का समर्थन कर सके जो फारसी भव्यता और स्थानीय डेक्कान परंपराओं को मिलाती थी।

questions.question_english:
46. Identify the INCORRECT statement regarding
ancient Indian sculptural traditions.
options_english:
Gandhara school of art was heavily influenced
by Greco-Roman artistic styles.

Mathura school of art primarily used red
sandstone to sculpt figures of Buddha, Jain
Tirthankaras, and Hindu deities.

Amaravati school of art excelled in narrative
relief sculptures using white marble/
limestone depicting the life of Buddha.

Gandhara art exclusively used red spotted
sandstone and avoided grey schist stone
entirely.
questions.explanation_english: The correct option is 'Gandhara art exclusively used red spotted sandstone and avoided grey schist stone entirely.' Ancient Indian sculpture developed through distinct artistic traditions. Gandhara art, located in the northwestern region, was heavily influenced by Greco-Roman styles and primarily utilized grey schist stone and stucco, rather than red sandstone. Mathura art, centered in Uttar Pradesh, prominently utilized characteristic spotted red sandstone. Amaravati art in the Krishna river valley excelled in narrative relief carvings executed on white limestone slabs.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। गंधार कला ने पूरी तरह से लाल धब्बेदार बलुआ पत्थर का उपयोग किया और ग्रे शिस्ट पत्थर से पूरी तरह से बचा। प्राचीन भारतीय मूर्तिकला विभिन्न कलात्मक परंपराओं के माध्यम से विकसित हुई। गंधार कला, जो उत्तर-पश्चिमी क्षेत्र में स्थित है, ग्रीको-रोमन शैलियों से गंभीर रूप से प्रभावित थी और मुख्य रूप से ग्रे शिस्ट पत्थर और स्टुको का उपयोग करती थी, न कि लाल बलुआ पत्थर का। मथुरा कला, जो उत्तर प्रदेश में केंद्रित है, ने विशेष रूप से लाल धब्बेदार बलुआ पत्थर का उपयोग किया। अमरावती कला कृष्णा नदी घाटी में सफेद संगमरमर पर कथात्मक राहत मूर्तियों में उत्कृष्टता प्राप्त करती है।
